Class Activity

java.lang.Object
org.example.sprint3.Activity
public class Activity extends Object
Represents an activity in a project schedule. Includes details such as ID, description, duration, cost, dependencies, and scheduling metrics.

      public Activity(String id, String description, int duration, String durationUnit, double cost, List<String> dependencies)
      Constructs an activity with the specified attributes.
      Parameters:
      id - Unique identifier for the activity.
      description - Description of the activity.
      duration - Duration of the activity.
      durationUnit - Unit of the duration (e.g., days, weeks).
      cost - Cost associated with the activity.
      dependencies - List of activity IDs that this activity depends on.
